comparison.objective: Seal a preloaded carton by closing four flaps and applying one continuous strip from an ordinary tape roll; candidate instead separates finishing media from washers with a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Flap folding, tape payout, adhesion and cutting versus bimanual screen handling, controlled pouring and orientation-dependent sifting/bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires contained products, closed flaps, bonded seam/end wraps, cut tape, parked tools and 2 s release; candidate requires full loading, at least 98% media recovery, every washer retained, no spill/damage/contamination, and 3 s released support dwell.
comparison.reason: The tested transformations and contact mechanics are materially different. PR is an incomplete draft without task.json or native proof, but its body and all supplied README/task.py/scoring.py versions define enough rubric detail for distinction.
